evidence: You will need to make transport arrangements as the start and end points of this hike are different.
You need the landowner's permission to walk to Purity Hut from the carpark at the end of Mangakukeke Road.
Climb the marked Purity Hut Track through farmland and forest to Purity Hut, nestled above the bushline on the Hikurangi Range.
Walk back on the McKinnon Hut Track along the crest of the Hikurangi Range from McKinnon Hut and down the long ridge to the cableway across the Kawhatau River.
From Kawhatau Base, go through the gate and down to the Kawhatau River. Head downstream for approximately 9.5 km to the Rangitane Road bridge.

doubts: Start: the Mangakukeke Road end has no road-end feature, so the ref is null; the page's first section is 'Mangakukeke Road end to Purity Hut'. End: the Rangitane Road bridge has no feature or name entry, so the ref is null. Shape: one_way, because the page says the start and end points differ and that transport must be arranged. Time is DOC's '3-4 days'; no distance is given on the page. The walk crosses the Kawhatau River by a cableway; the page says it is easy to walk across unless the river is up, but the cableway is the crossing the route describes, so no ford is recorded. Mangaweka Trig is matched to the peak Mangaweka (T5) by position on the tops, not by name. Kawhatau Base has no entry. The 9 km walk up the Kawhatau River from the Rangitane Road bridge is recorded as an access point to Kawhatau Base, not as a separate way, because the page gives it no heading of its own.
